description: This Java source file defines the MainActivity class for an Android application. It manages UI actions such as toggling a log view, setting up the initial fragment, and initializing logging mechanics. The class extends SampleActivityBase and incorporates fragments, menu options, and logging facilities.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that serves as the launcher for the app, managing fragment setup, menu interactions, and logging initialization.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and adds the main fragment if not restoring from saved state.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu from XML resources.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Configures menu items based on current UI state, particularly the log toggle visibility and title.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, notably toggling the log view between visible states.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up the logging chain, connecting log wrappers, filters, and on-screen log display components.
